title: Woman writes book about paranormal side of Roanoke
excerpt: Why the author felt compelled to write these stories and share with readers.
content:
ROANOKE, Va. (WDBJ) - Anita Allen just finished her book, “Nothing Ever Happens Here, Paranormal Events, Hauntings, High Strangeness and more in the Roanoke Valley.”

She stops by to tell us all about it on Here @ Home and shares how she collected witness accounts about these happenings, many of which took longer then expected as witnesses often felt that their stories were not interesting because they weren’t scary - but definitely full of intrigue and mystery.
